stages.goal: Add the millimetres/inches selector: blade width, board and piece entry and display in the selected unit (decimal inches, fractions and text refused), lengths kept in millimetres so switching never changes a measurement, and the to-scale layout with piece, kerf and offcut lengths in the selected unit.
tasks: public/js/units.mjs (new, architecture §5a, ADR-003): parseLength(raw, unit) -> mm (inches × 25.4, unrounded) or { ok: false, message } refusing zero, negative, non-numeric, fractions such as 3/4 and text such as 31in (inches message asks for a decimal number of inches); formatNumber/formatLength rounding to 3 decimals in inches and 2 in mm with trailing zeros dropped; unitSymbol, unitName, normalizeUnit.

public/index.html, public/js/app.mjs, public/styles.css: a unit selector offering millimetres and inches (mm by default); every length label shows the selected unit; blade, board and piece fields show formatNumber(stored, unit) and parse typed values with parseLength(raw, unit); a field left unedited is never written back; switching unit only re-renders from the unchanged plan.

public/js/app.mjs: every length in the layout (piece lengths and labels, kerf marks, offcut, captions, summaries) through formatLength(mm, unit); segment proportions and data-length-mm stay in millimetres (R2.5).
public/js/planner.mjs: keep validateQuantity and the mm arithmetic unchanged; accept non-integer millimetre lengths everywhere.

tests/: node:test unit tests for units (94.5 in -> 2400.3 mm, 31.5 in -> 800.1 mm, 0.25 in -> 6.35 mm; 2400/800/3 mm -> 94.488/31.496/0.118 in; 794 mm -> 31.26 in; 3/4 and 31in refused; repeated mm<->in display round trips leave stored values unchanged) and the existing layout tests still passing.
integration_obligations: The saved plan shape and the in-memory plan stay exactly spec §9 (version 1, millimetres); the unit is not part of the plan.
web-ui does no conversion or rounding itself: all parsing and formatting go through units.mjs, all placement and kerf arithmetic through planner-core's computeLayout.
Iteration 1 behaviour in millimetres (R1.1–R1.4, R2.1–R2.4) is unchanged with millimetres selected.

stages.goal: Unplaced explanations and move refusals in the selected unit, the selected unit saved and restored with iteration 1 plans reopening unchanged in millimetres, and a cut sheet that states its unit and gives every length in it.
tasks: public/js/planner.mjs: computeLayout(plan, unit = 'mm') and checkMove(plan, layout, instanceId, boardId, unit = 'mm') keep reason lengths in mm and format their sentences with units.formatLength, each figure converted from its own mm value (R3.6: 'need 94.724 in (94.488 in of pieces plus 0.236 in for 2 cuts) but the board is 94.488 in'); placement never depends on the unit.

public/js/store.mjs: loadUnit/saveUnit on localStorage key cutPlanner.unit ('mm' when missing, unrecognised or storage throws); clearPlan keeps the unit; loadPlan unchanged so an iteration 1 plan with no unit opens as is in mm.

public/js/app.mjs: load the unit on start before the first render, save it when the selector changes; pass the unit to computeLayout and checkMove; unplaced panel, add-board and move controls keep working in both units.

Cut sheet (index.html, app.mjs, styles.css): a line at the top stating the unit (millimetres or inches); blade width, board lengths, pieces in cutting order, offcuts and unplaced pieces all via formatLength with the unit symbol; print stylesheet still hides controls including the unit selector.

tests/: node:test unit tests for unplaced and move-refusal sentences in inches (R3.6, R3.4), loadUnit/saveUnit with missing, unrecognised and throwing storage, clearPlan keeping the unit, and the iteration 1 saved plan (3 mm, 2400 mm, three 800 mm, no unit) loading unchanged with mm selected and the R3.1 layout.
integration_obligations: Stage 1 entry, unit switching and layout keep working, now with the unit restored from and saved to cutPlanner.unit.
cutPlanner.plan keeps exactly the spec §9 shape in millimetres; a value saved by iteration 1 is read without migration.
The cut sheet and the screen are produced from the same computeLayout result and the same selected unit.

notes: Phase 2 of iteration 2 delivers the gained criteria (R1.5–R1.7, R2.5, R3.6, R4.5, R4.6, R5.5) while re-validating every criterion of R1–R5. Architecture version 2 adds the units module (public/js/units.mjs), the cutPlanner.unit key and ADR-003.
